digestRules.inputDigest: Opaque Java-issued immutable report/input token. Worker stores and echoes; no recomputation.
digestRules.checkInputDigest: Opaque Java-issued current semantic state token. Distinct from worker model bundle digest.
digestRules.serverCanonical: Java AnalysisStateJournal: UTF-16 lexicographically sorted object keys, no whitespace, array order preserved, unescaped Unicode/no NFC normalization, JSON null, finite plain minimal decimal numbers.
digestRules.workerBundle: Existing Python json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True) including default spaces, before adding input_digest. Preserve unchanged; metadata only, never authorization.
digestRules.idempotency: Server hashes operation + typed command (null fields retained); scope excluded for same-input cross-generation semantic replay, except COMPLETE includes scope. Publication keys are report-wide across branches.

bookSourceRead.meaning: Only full book read is complete; target×book review is separate BOOK_COVERAGE grid, even while Python aggregate BOOK_SOURCE.status is still UNPROCESSED.

authorCorrectionProofs.projectionAuthority: author_correction is null; raw plural proof metadata is trusted-server transport only, never wildcard time/condition authority.
authorCorrectionProofs.disagreementPolicy: DB_RAW_DISAGREEMENT remains NEEDS_CONTEXT in v1. Actual CURRENT_VALUE correction is recorded and applied to new frozen baseline, but free-text narrative time/condition authority is never inferred.

execution.runtimeDefault: DISABLED; no implicit historical backfill. Explicit START/RECHECK same-key recovery or RETRY queues ready reports.
execution.completion: Only current completed checks, completed typo segments, and server-derived fully covered NO_CHECK segments count as successful processing. Planner/read/grid preparation alone is not PARTIAL. Both full required grids and all current checks are required for COMPLETED.
execution.publicResultBoundary: Only status/counts/coverage summaries/check summaries/findings/verified source quotes. No full evidence_bundle, catalogue, checkpoint, lease or provider usage-call ledger.

retryBudgetPolicy.exhausted: 409 VALIDATION_EXECUTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED if any required unfinished role remains exhausted
retryBudgetPolicy.replay: Original immutable RETRY response_snapshot, no new generation/budget refresh
retryBudgetPolicy.optionalEmbedding: First explicit role+model introduction only if no earlier embedding calls or successful vector receipt, using existing retrieval-compatible text-embedding-3-small; used model is never silently replaced

requiredTask3EmbeddingPreflight.deny: Actually required new embedding with exhausted cumulative cap returns 409 before queueing.
requiredTask3EmbeddingPreflight.allow: Verified compatible successful query receipt with only JUDGE remaining is admitted with zero extra embedding calls.
requiredTask3EmbeddingPreflight.proofSource: Original immutable validation_call_input and authenticated typed semantic checkpoint; never model output or a VECTOR string alone.

clueAuthority.source: Full T1 READ_SOURCE response.modelClues (clueVersion=1); same grid.modelClues after first semantic publication
clueAuthority.execution: Worker must use server CL refs/spans; only nojob callable may recalculate Python collect_clues
clueAuthority.matching: Existing ASCII [0-9] only, Python Unicode whitespace including U+001C..001F, codepoint [start,end), sorted unique (start,end,kind); repeated literal nonempty names only when count>1; deduplicate aliases
clueAuthority.modelInput: Only clues whose start falls in current segment core; exact clue_checks set with CHECKED/NOT_APPLICABLE required. Hints never findings/facts.

bootstrapOrder: claim: trusted scope, versions, limits, models, existing checkpoint
GET checkpoint is permitted with gridReady=false and does not read any source
ENTRIES pages: canonical modelSettings + authorCorrectionProofs (global stable S-refs)
full T1 READ_SOURCE: validated text + clueVersion=1/modelClues
SETTING/TYPO run independently; persist each validated target stage and book stage immediately. Finish each ready book before the next; pendingBookRefs never become empty books.
publish each validated semantic stage, then MERGED_PLAN before first JUDGE; restore stable server check IDs/revisions
publish DECIDED + original evidence_bundle/current server checkInputDigest, or successful TYPO segment

BOOK_SOURCE.meaning: Only full book read is complete; target×book review is separate BOOK_COVERAGE grid, even while Python aggregate BOOK_SOURCE.status is still UNPROCESSED.

savedSeedRecovery.sameInput: Verify original seed hash/fingerprint, unchanged target and full frozen source row/lifetime metadata under Work, reuse materialize, queue same report/baselineRevision
savedSeedRecovery.rawSourceRead: No S3 under the Work recovery lock; leased source reader verifies actual bytes before models/publication

execution.plansBoundary: SETTING only; TYPO_SEGMENT must use /units classification/suggestion/coverage validation. /plans TYPO returns 400 without any stage/publication/version write.

progressiveSourceGrid.serverAuthority: All manifest BOOK_SOURCE obligations exist before book lengths are known; client required-grid or lengths never authorize completion
progressiveSourceGrid.readyBookRow: Existing sourceRef/totalCodePoints/plannedChecks/segments, created only by successful full-source validation plus BOOK_SOURCE publication
progressiveSourceGrid.semantics: Pending is unknown length and required review, never an empty book or zero required checks
progressiveSourceGrid.publication: PLANNER/RELATED_SELECTION/COVERAGE/checkpoint save without reading unrelated books. BOOK_SOURCE reads only its missing source. Citations still require actual bytes for their exact refs.
progressiveSourceGrid.commit: Under Work, merge discoveries monotonically with the latest grid and revalidate all frozen source metadata/current input/lease. Different known dimensions or source changes are conflicts.
progressiveSourceGrid.completion: Any pending book blocks MERGED_PLAN, SETTING completion, and NO_CHECK success. After all book lengths are known, a fully covered target segment remains successful while other segments are incomplete.
progressiveSourceGrid.retry: Restore successful stage payloads/server book segments/receipt IDs; read only unfinished book rules. Actual Worker/provider-count tests prove saved planner and successful first-book processing calls0; first book full reads0 in zero-question resume.

comparisonEvidenceBoundary.target: T1 context or an E-ref whose actual source_ref is T1 remains valid context, but cannot authorize CONFLICT/SUSPECTED_CONFLICT
comparisonEvidenceBoundary.allowed: A validated frozen fact or E-ref whose actual verified frozen source is not T1

payloadCitationPaths.canonicalSettings: settings[] must exactly equal the server-issued known entry projection; text/quote inside that authenticated state are ordinary domain keys
payloadCitationPaths.otherCopies: text/quote in undeclared payload/checkpoint objects are invalid; typed spans/context still require exact supplied citation and actual source hash/position checks

queryEmbeddingIdentity.reservation: QUERY_EMBEDDING requires queryInput; every generation role requires null. Immutable validation_call_input belongs to the original ValidationJob usage request. Replaying a requestId with another identity is rejected.
queryEmbeddingIdentity.queryHashRule: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 query sent to the provider; no trim, Unicode normalization or case folding.
queryEmbeddingIdentity.versionSource: Existing chat.retrieval-embedding-version, including explicit override; dimensions are existing retrieval_chunks vector(1536).
queryEmbeddingIdentity.reuse: Authenticated v1 semantic checkpoint receipt for the current exact VECTOR obligation, SUCCEEDED/READY with complete current index scope, original SETTLED SUCCESS query usage with exactly matching queryInput, current input/manifest/model/version/dimensions. JUDGE-only retry consumes zero extra embedding calls.
queryEmbeddingIdentity.deny: Failed/partial/unready/incompatible/changed-query/input/manifest/index proof cannot bypass an exhausted role cap; retry responds 409 VALIDATION_EXECUTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED before queueing.

semanticCheckpoint.authority: Current server checkId/revision/checkInputDigest/outcome/state.lookup_obligations, not checkpoint completion flags.
semanticCheckpoint.phase: PLANNING or JUDGING; evidence exists in only one phase location.
semanticCheckpoint.planning: Only book_origins and exact evidence needed by actual book questions. BOOK_SOURCE and BOOK_COVERAGE stages and server book segments are the restoration source; no whole-book text copy.
semanticCheckpoint.runtime: Typed global receipts plus question own_receipt_refs, remaining LookupIntent/bool queue, targetContexts/additional_target_context text spans, baseline selections and observed check revisions. No stage payload or saved decision duplication.
semanticCheckpoint.revision: All affected checks revise atomically. The same-input checkpoint version advances while authenticated receipts remain. Source/report invalidation still deletes all copies. Reclaim after revise-before-checkpoint reconstructs missing obligations from current server checks.
semanticCheckpoint.books: Finish and publish each book before reading another. Resume successful stages with zero provider calls; unfinished book rules use the existing lease-scoped READ_SOURCE range and exact source verification.
semanticCheckpoint.transport: 131072-byte publication ceiling and exact citation validation are unchanged; no hidden text fields or increased limits.
